title: Listening to Jim Hall's trio
summary: They listen to a live Jim Hall trio recording of "Scrapple from the Apple" and Rosenberg asks Bunn to repeat his comments.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Well, I was thinking that maybe just right off we could talk about what music we were just listening
Well, just for the record, just so it's on the tape. We've just been listening to Jim Hall, a live recording.
With his trio. And I think it was "Scrapple from the Apple," and "The Way You Look Tonight."
And a couple of other tunes. And it would be worth kind of going back over that conversation, like your comments, because I thought they were interesting.
What was the name of it, "Scrapple --
"Scrapple from the Apple." A Charlie Parker tune.
We just played -- the one we just listened to.
The one that just went off?
Yeah, right. I just wanted you to repeat your the comments about --
Well, it sounds all right to me.
